messages:
Maya (partnerships): quick sync — running a short partner launch sprint handoff. goal: rehearsal of announcement scenarios across marketplace listings, partner landing pages, and press ops. can we confirm owners + blockers?
Liam (marketing): I can own partner-facing comms and the blog snippet. need final hero copy and partner logos in SVG by EOD Tue. cc @Olivia for feature callouts. :eyes:
Olivia (product): sending the 2-line feature bullets now. also: we should surface quantized model variants and latency callouts on the partner page. will drop copy in the drive.
Rajesh (engineering): staging tiles up for AWS/Azure marketplace. tile URL: https://staging.marketplace.redwood.ai/tiles/acrosoft. small CI note: the tile manifest needs a region tag for eu-west-1 or the pipeline fails. i pushed fix to branch marketplace/region-tag.
Maya (partnerships): thanks — Rajesh can you add a tiny checklist for SI customers (install steps, sample manifest, support contact)? partners want a one-pager.
Rajesh (engineering): yes. adding two artifacts: 1) quickstart.md 2) sample-manifest.json. snippet: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://staging.api.redwood.ai/partner/manifest```
Liam (marketing): localization request — we have en, fr, de. partner asks for ja and ko as well. do we have translation budget?
Nora (legal): embargo windows: partner AcroSoft asked for a 48hr heads-up before live. legal ok with co-announcement language, need to sign the final partner quote. I'll circulate doc for e-sign by tomorrow.
Maya (partnerships): timeline proposal: Tue morning creative freeze, Tue afternoon partner legal sign, Wed morning rehearsal with press ops, Wed afternoon publish to staging/partners, Thu go-live for marketplace tiles. objections?
Liam (marketing): works for marketing; I'll schedule the rehearsal and invite press ops + partner comms. rehearsal agenda: 1) headline readout 2) landing page walk-through 3) press Q&A run-through 4) rollback checklist.
Olivia (product): can we add a short FAQ section on the landing page about supported deployment modes (hosted/dedicated/private)? partners often ping on that.
Rajesh (engineering): one small risk: Dedicated capacity metrics not populated in the tile until we flip the telem flag. ETA to flip: 6 hours after artifact deploy. flag toggle documented here: https://go/repo/marketplace-flags.
Maya (partnerships): noted — Rajesh please add an alert to rehearsal agenda so ops can simulate a telemetry gap.
press-bot: PressOps scheduled: rehearsal 2026-03-25 16:00 UTC. Calendar invite sent to @Liam @Maya @Olivia @Rajesh @Nora.
Liam (marketing): asset checklist for partners (quick): hero image (1200x600), SVG logos (transparent), 2 product bullets, partner quote (max 120 chars), localized meta description. I'll collate in the campaign doc.
Maya (partnerships): owners summary: marketing -> comms + blog (Liam), product -> feature bullets + FAQ (Olivia), eng -> staging tiles + quickstart (Rajesh), legal -> partner sign (Nora). next sync in Slack thread after creative freeze. :thumbsup:
Nora (legal): uploaded partner agreement for signature: https://drive.redwood.ai/acrosoft/partner-agreement-v3. please review by EOD Tue.
Liam (marketing): putting final hero options in #design and pinging @design for A/B pick.
Maya (partnerships): perfect — any last blockers? if none I'll close this thread and start a rehearsal thread with notes after the run.
Olivia (product): none from product.
Rajesh (engineering): none, will post deploy logs after staging push.
Nora (legal): none.
Maya (partnerships): great — closing for now. reply here if anything changes.
